item.title: CVE-2026-132825
item.description: Ruby before 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 has a heap-based buffer overflow during case conversion. One byte can be written outside a buffer for, for example, ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252.

item.title: ALTCHA: Nil-map panic (pre-verification DoS) in v1 parseServerSignature on malformed VerificationData

Go's url.ParseQuery returns the successfully-parsed pairs together with a non-nil error when the query string contains a malformed percent-escape. A subsequent loop unconditionally writes unknown keys into Extra , regardless of…

item.title: bep/imagemeta: Unbounded memory allocation decoding PNG zTXt "Raw profile type iptc" chunks
item.description: A crafted PNG can make imagemeta.Decode allocate memory far in excess of the input file's size, leading to memory exhaustion. Two separate paths in the zTXt "Raw profile type iptc" branch are affected: the declared chunk length drives an allocation directly, and the embedded zlib stream is decompressed without an output bound. A 42-byte file allocated 256 MB, and a 127 KB file allocated 460 MB. Impact Denial of…

item.title: Aether Project amf: panic on an unrecovered NGAP goroutine
item.description: Summary HandlePathSwitchRequest guards the UESecurityCapabilities IE for presence but never for length, and the extensible APER type silently yields an empty bit string, so six unguarded index-zero reads panic on an unrecovered goroutine and terminate the AMF. The AMF is the control-plane entry point for a 5G core, so terminating it drops mobility management for every subscriber. Confirmed at HEAD daed5a2 (present…

item.title: Bolt ListFormatHelper SQL injection
item.description: Impact SQL Injection in ListFormatHelper allows authenticated users with the upload permission to execute arbitrary SQL queries and exfiltrate sensitive database contents through the /async/select-options endpoint when general/caching/list format is enabled. Patches This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

item.title: Bolt: Prevent SSRF due to unchecked followed redirects
item.description: Impact The /bolt/async/upload-url and /bolt/async/embed endpoints validated only the submitted URL before fetching it server-side, but the fetch then followed redirects to destinations that were never re-validated . This allowed an authenticated user to bypass the SSRF guard ( UrlSafetyChecker ) and make the server issue requests to internal/cloud-metadata addresses. Patches This issue has been patched with Bolt…

item.title: Bolt: Information disclosure through unfiltered public relation API endpoint
item.description: Impact A missing access-control filter in the public Relation API allowed unauthenticated users to discover metadata about unpublished, draft, and viewless content through REST and GraphQL endpoints. Patches This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

item.title: Bolt: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in URL-upload and embed endpoints
item.description: Impact Two authenticated backend endpoints fetched a user-supplied URL server-side with no protection against internal targets. Patches This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

item.title: Bolt: Open redirect enables post-authentication redirection to arbitrary domains
item.description: Impact Open redirect vulnerabilities in LoginFormAuthenticator allow attackers to redirect users to attacker-controlled domains after login success or login failure, enabling phishing attacks and potential token theft. Patches This has been patched in Bolt 6.1.4.

item.title: Enforce maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1
item.description: Enforce a recursion limit in Unmarshal to prevent stack exhaustion when parsing deeply-nested, recursive structures.

item.title: Quadratic complexity in WordDecoder.DecodeHeader in mime
item.description: Decoding a maliciously-crafted MIME header containing many invalid encoded-words can consume excessive CPU.

This was caused by a bug in our process for replacing control-plane servers in one of our compute clusters.…
